facts.fact: Vero 吞掉手铐钥匙，使 Brawley 无法强行把两人分开
facts.anchor: “I swallowed it. Figured you can’t force us to separate that way.”

facts.fact: Brawley 警告 Clay 碰 Vero 就杀他，Kayla 判断他是认真的
本章 Vero 第三次宣告喜欢 Kayla，并问 Brawley 能否「留下她」
facts.anchor: I really, really like her. Brawley, can we keep her? I want to keep her.”

facts.fact: 墓穴不是 Clay 挖的，岛上所有墓穴由 Noa 负责
facts.anchor: “Noa digs all the graves, and this one is no different.”

facts.fact: Kayla 在墓底反唇相讥，拒绝为 Clay 的推搡道歉
facts.anchor: “You have never once in your life successfully handled a woman, have you?”

facts.fact: Clay 在追逐中掐住 Kayla 的颈致她失去意识，Kayla 的叙述明确把这从游戏快感剥离为真实死亡恐惧
facts.anchor: this is done with no care.

facts.fact: Clay 事后威胁：再动 Jess 就杀她，把本章冲突与 Clay 护妹动机连上
facts.anchor: If you mess with Jess again, I will fucking kill you.

facts.fact: Clay 再次扼颈致 Kayla 昏迷，失去意识前她看见 Clay 身后有光
facts.anchor: As I fade out, I glimpse a glow behind Clay. Then my eyes close.
